features: Brisk baseline combat pace for players, pets, and monsters from Level 1 onward, with smooth attack speed, steady TP generation, and responsive casting.
Progressive Level 1–75 boss-like combat tuning across regular monsters and Notorious Monsters so fights stay engaging as your Soul Crystal and Weaponskill Talents grow.
Generous EXP per kill with extended chain windows and rewarding chain bonuses to match the deliberate, tactical combat pace.
Fair level-gap difficulty progression: Even Match through Incredibly Tough foes reward strong Soul builds, while far higher-level enemies act as a steep party challenge.
Anti-one-shot normalization on self-destruct and breath attacks so high-HP encounters remain readable and survivable.

baselinePlayerPace.desc: Brisk combat speed right from Level 1 without needing endgame Haste gear first.
Faster TP generation on every melee and ranged swing.
Steady passive TP regeneration while engaged in battle.
Snappier spell casting and shorter recasts across all jobs.

petCombatPace.desc: Applied automatically to all player pets, avatars, automatons, and companions.
Faster pet TP generation across all companion types.
Continuous pet TP regeneration while fighting.

mobScaling.normalLv25: Monsters gain steady durability, offense, accuracy, and speed as you progress through early and mid levels.
mobScaling.normalLv75: At the Level 75 cap, enemies are tuned to challenge fully realized Soul Crystal kits and invested Weaponskill Talent Trees.
mobScaling.nmBonus: Notorious Monsters are significantly tougher and faster than standard foes, rewarding coordinated cooldowns and party synergy.
mobScaling.levelGap: Enemies near your level provide a steady solo pace; Tough through Incredibly Tough foes reward strong builds; enemies 8 or more levels above you present a steep defensive wall.

levelGapTable.note: Steep defensive wall; bring a party

qolCards.title: All 22 Jobs Unlocked on Login
qolCards.desc: Every standard job from Warrior to Rune Fencer and Geomancer is unlocked immediately at character creation.

qolCards.title: 80-Slot Wardrobes 1–8 & Bags
qolCards.desc: Inventory, Mog Safe 1 & 2, Storage, Locker, Satchel, Sack, Case, and all 8 Mog Wardrobes are expanded to 80 slots automatically.

qolCards.title: 5 Trusts & All 9 Rhapsodies KIs
qolCards.desc: All 9 Rhapsodies of Vana'diel key items are granted on login, allowing up to 5 Trusts in a party immediately.

qolCards.title: 29-Item BiS Lv.1 Starter Kit & 263-Weapon Shop
qolCards.desc: New characters receive a 29-item BiS Lv.1 Starter Kit automatically and can open the 6-page Lv.1 Weapons Shop anywhere via !weapons.

qolCards.title: Auto-Capped Combat & Magic Skills
qolCards.desc: Weapon, defense, and magic skills automatically cap for your level so you can swap weapons and specs freely without skill-up grinding.

qolCards.title: Anti-One-Shot Breath & Suicide Normalization
qolCards.desc: Bomb Toss, Self-Destruct, Mijin Gakure, and HP-scaled breaths are capped to fair percentages of target Max HP.

weaponConfigurations.summary: Dual one-handed wielding unlocked at Lv. 10 using Dagger and Sword pairings.
Extended template supporting dual Great Axe wielding (scheduled in Extended Soul Weapon Templates).
Extended template supporting Polearm paired with a Size-1 Buckler (scheduled in Extended Soul Weapon Templates).

companions.name: Eos (Light Pixie)
companions.role: Party Healer, Regen Buffer & Debuff Cleanser
companions.summary: A dedicated server-side faerie companion that grows alongside the Scholar. Automatically maintains a stackable Eos Regen across the master, party members, and Trusts, and prioritizes removing harmful debuffs with -na spells and Erase.
companions.specialItem: Orphic Egg: Repurposed as a Scholar-only ammo item that grants steady MP Refresh to Eos and Titania.

companions.name: Titania (Dark Pixie)
companions.role: Dark Arts Enfeebler, Drain/Aspir & Elemental Nuker
companions.summary: A Dark Arts faerie companion that grows alongside the Scholar. Automatically locks onto the Scholar's spell target, weakens enemies with enfeebling magic, sustains herself with Drain and Aspir, and casts elemental nukes.
companions.specialItem: Orphic Egg: Grants steady MP Refresh to Titania.

companions.name: Undead Warrior & Dullahan
companions.summary: Resilient melee undead thralls that protect their master, draw enemy attention, activate the Necromancer's Dark Pact combat bonuses, receive healing from Harbinger's Drain on Scythe weaponskills, and execute Grim Reaping on command (or detonate via Corpse Explosion).
spells: Grim Reaping (30s CD physical cleave + self-heal)
Corpse Explosion (45s CD Dark AoE detonation)
companions.specialItem: All Scythes unlocked for Black Mage with A+ Scythe Skill when Necromancer is socketed.

companions.name: Undead Mage & Corse
companions.role: Backline Dark Caster & MP Siphon Thrall
companions.summary: Caster undead thralls wielding dark and elemental magic. They maintain Dark Pact for the Necromancer and unleash Grim Incantations on command, dealing dark magic damage while siphoning MP back to the master.
spells: Grim Incantations (30s CD Dark burst + Master MP drain)
Corse Bonus: Empowered burst that inflicts Magic Defense Down
Corpse Explosion (45s CD Dark AoE detonation)
companions.specialItem: Grim Conversion Trait: Converts mage-oriented casting stats into frontline Scythe combat strength.

equipmentLines.gearAssistance: Use !gear and Soul equipment progression lines to equip role-appropriate gear from Lv. 1 through Lv. 75.

features.name: All 66 Job Soul Crystals
features.summary: Every one of Vana'diel's 22 classic jobs branches into three distinct Soul Crystals unlocking at Lv. 10, each with bespoke abilities, spells, traits, stances, and tactical playstyles.
highlights: 22 classic FFXI jobs with 3 canonical Souls each (66 total).
Soul-specific action identities replace repurposed base abilities in-game and across the wiki.
Switch Souls freely via Soul Crystals or the !spec command at Lv. 10+.

features.name: Weapon Skill Talent System (219 Trees)
features.summary: Every Weaponskill across all 15 weapon categories features a 4-tier spec-adaptive talent tree with a shared character talent budget of 225 points at Lv. 75.
highlights: 219 bespoke Weaponskill trees spanning Tier 1 through Tier 4 capstones.
Adaptive talent views tailored to DPS, Tank, Arcana, Healer, and Tactical playstyles.
Earn 3 talent points per level from Lv. 1 to Lv. 75.

features.name: Soul Weapon Configuration System
features.summary: Data-driven per-Soul main-hand and offhand equipment rules that allow signature archetypes to wield non-standard weapon combinations cleanly.
highlights: Dual one-handed wielding live for Bard Skald (sword and dagger pairings).
Validated on both server equipment rules and native client equipment UI.

features.name: Soul Mechanics, Resource Systems & Companions
features.summary: Distinct resource loops—including Grit, Rhythm, Runes, Shadow Clones, and bespoke Soul Companions—reshape party synergy and solo pacing.
highlights: Custom Soul companions including Eos, Titania, and Necromancer undead thralls.
Dedicated Dancer Chakram progression gear from Lv. 10 through Lv. 75.
Unified attack-rate pacing and modern Lv. 99 quality-of-life conveniences within a Lv. 75 cap.

features.name: Level Sync & Equipment Progression
features.summary: Level 75 cap progression paired with Level 10+ Level Sync, role-aware !gear assistance, and curated Soul equipment lines.
highlights: Level Sync lets veterans and newcomers adventure together across leveling ranges.
Quick-access !gear and starter kit utilities ease progression from Lv. 1 to Lv. 75.

features.name: Burrows Reborn — The First Descent (Lv. 10)
features.summary: Early-game instanced encounter prototype designed to introduce party mechanics, Soul synergy, and level-synced group play starting at Lv. 10.
highlights: Instanced encounter prototype accessible from Lv. 10.
Built for small-group coordination and early Soul mastery.

features.name: Invite-Only Public Alpha & Soulspire Launcher
features.summary: Dedicated Windows launcher with automatic updates paired with invite-code Public Alpha account registration.
highlights: One-click SoulspireLauncher v2.1.0 with transactional updates.
Self-service invite-only account registration at soulspirexi.com/register.

features.name: Extended Soul Weapon Templates (Dual 2H & 2H + Shield)
features.summary: Expands the Soul Weapon Configuration System with Dual Two-Handed wielding (Warrior Berserker) and Two-Handed + Shield setups (Warrior Spartan).
highlights: Dual two-handed weapon pairing support for Warrior Berserker.
Two-handed spear and shield pairing support for Warrior Spartan.

features.name: Unified Soulspire Core UI, Soul HUD & Soulforge Talents
features.summary: Next-generation responsive in-game UI suite unifying the Soul HUD, Soulforge Weaponskill Talent browser, and native runtime Soul identity display.
highlights: Interactive in-game Soulforge talent tree interface.
Responsive Soul resource HUD and unified native menu styling.

features.name: Corsair Flintlock Dual-Pistol Auto-Shoot
features.summary: Authoritative dual-pistol ranged auto-shoot combat flow for Corsair Flintlock, pairing visual twin-pistol holsters with seamless ranged tempo.
highlights: Dedicated ranged-first combat cadence for Corsair Flintlock.
Currently undergoing staging playtests prior to live release.

features.name: Formal Armor Progression & Soul Mastery
features.summary: Dedicated Soul-driven armor progression tiers, modernized !gear recommendations, and long-term Soul Mastery milestones.
highlights: Role-tailored equipment progression milestones across Lv. 10 to Lv. 75.
Planned for upcoming alpha progression updates.
